summary: Text Fields - Accented character forces next letter into uppercase
reported_issue: When a user types an accented character (such as e-acute, a-grave, etc.), the following character automatically becomes uppercase. Occurs in text inputs like customer/vendor name.
expected_after_fix: After typing an accented character the next letter should remain as typed (lowercase). All automatic text transformations should be removed - text should remain exactly as the user types it.
steps_i_followed: Opened Parts -> Vendors -> New vendor dialog
Focused the vendor Name text field and typed, character by character (80ms delay), 'naïve café test' entirely in lowercase
Cleared and typed 'aébc déf' (accent immediately followed by a letter) and read back the value
actual_now: The field preserves exactly what was typed: 'naïve café test' -> 'naïve café test', and 'aébc déf' -> 'aébc déf'. The character following an accented character is NOT converted to uppercase, and no auto-capitalization/transformation is applied.
notes: Verified on the Vendor name text field (same input component family cited in the report as customer/vendor name). No forced uppercase after accents; text transformation removed as expected.
